an5.139:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo na rājāraho hoti na rājabhoggo, na rañño aṅgan tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.139:1.3: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ, akkhamo saddānaṃ, akkhamo gandhānaṃ, akkhamo rasānaṃ, akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ? 3.
an5.139:2.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato hatthikāyaṃ vā disvā assakāyaṃ vā disvā rathakāyaṃ vā disvā pattikāyaṃ vā disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ.
an5.139:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ? 4.
an5.139:3.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato hatthisaddaṃ vā sutvā assasaddaṃ vā sutvā rathasaddaṃ vā sutvā pattisaddaṃ vā sutvā bheripaṇavasaṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddaṃ vā sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ.
an5.139:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ? 5.
an5.139:4.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato, ye te rañño nāgā abhijātā saṃgāmāvacarā, tesaṃ muttakarīsassa gandhaṃ ghāyitvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambati, na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ.
an5.139:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ? 6.
an5.139:5.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nago saṃgāmagato ekissā vā tiṇodakadattiyā vimānito dvīhi vā tīhi vā catūhi vā pañcahi vā tiṇodakadattīhi vimānito saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ.
an5.139:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ? 7.
an5.139:6.2: Idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato ekena vā saravegena viddho dvīhi vā tīhi vā catūhi vā pañcahi vā saravegehi viddho saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati, na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.139:6.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:7.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo na rājāraho hoti na rājabhoggo, na rañño aṅgan tveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.139:8.1: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na āhuneyyo hoti na pāhuneyyo na dakkhiṇeyyo na añjalikaraṇīyo na anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an5.139:8.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ, akkhamo saddānaṃ, akkhamo gandhānaṃ, akkhamo rasānaṃ, akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
an5.139:9.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ? 9.
an5.139:9.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rajanīye rūpe sārajjati, na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ.
an5.139:9.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ.
an5.139:10.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ? 10.
an5.139:10.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā rajanīye sadde sārajjati, na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ.
an5.139:10.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti saddānaṃ.
an5.139:11.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ? 11.
an5.139:11.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā rajanīye gandhe sārajjati, na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ.
an5.139:11.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti gandhānaṃ.
an5.139:12.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rasānam? 12.
an5.139:12.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā rajanīye rase sārajjati, na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ.
an5.139:12.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rasānaṃ.
an5.139:13.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ? 13.
an5.139:13.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā rajanīye phoṭṭhabbe sārajjati, na sakkoti cittaṃ samādahituṃ.
an5.139:13.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
